{{Redirect3|Summoning monster(s)|Reanimation spells}}
[[File:Superior ghostly thrall.png|right|130px]]
'''Thralls''' are undead beings which can be summoned to attack enemies.

==Overview==
Thralls are summoned with [[resurrection spells]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]], which requires completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]]. In addition to the required [[Magic]] level and runes, the player must have the [[Book of the Dead]] either wielded or in their inventory, along with 2-6 prayer points in order to summon a thrall.

The [[impish whistle]] can be used to unlock a cosmetic override for thralls, giving them the appearances of imps.

Casting these spells does not interrupt combat. The player will keep attacking their current target and will not have their attacks delayed or otherwise affected.

Thralls notably always deal [[successful hit]]s, with the damage roll ranging from 0-3 depending on the tier of spell used, as well as ignoring the [[flat armour]] stat. This makes them fairly powerful allies for prolonged encounters, speed-based [[Combat Achievements]], and places where magic spells (not including powered staves) are not needed. 

Thralls have an [[attack speed]] of 4, or once every 2.4 seconds. Skeletal and Ghostly thralls have an [[attack range]] of 6, with the distance reduced by 1 when attacking from the defending NPC's south or west side. It may be inferred that the attack range is calculated using the distance from the south-west corner of the thrall, to the north-east corner of the defending NPC, repeated for every tile occupied by the defending NPC. 

Thralls cannot attack other players. Damage dealt by the thrall counts as damage dealt by the player that summoned it. 

The magic thralls' projectiles will hit enemies 1-2 ticks earlier (depending on distance) than the ranged thralls. Therefore, magic thralls are preferred whenever there are no special type resistances. Some bosses, however, such as [[The Hueycoatl]], have blue-coloured attacks to dodge, so the ranged thrall can be preferable as to not be confused with or masking away a dangerous tile, as he is yellow.

Thralls will remain for a set amount of time (<math>0.6 * CurrentMagicLevel</math> seconds (i.e. 1 [[tick]] per level)), or twice as long after claiming the [[Master Combat Achievements]] rewards. There is a ten second cooldown before the player can cast another resurrection spell, although the current thrall will despawn in the process.

As the thrall's duration is dependent on the player's Magic level, boosting it will subsequently increase the thrall's duration:

{{notelist}}

Thralls cannot pass between rooms (for example, a thrall summoned in the [[Corporeal Beast]] lobby will remain there even when the player enters the Beast's arena and attacks it)

===Restrictions===
Thralls cannot be resurrected at the following locations:

* [[Castle Wars]]
* [[Chasm of Fire]] (with the exception of Yama's Domain)
* [[Clan Wars]]
* Certain [[Temple Trekking]] encounters
* During the fight against [[Galvek]]
* During the fight against [[Robert the Strong]]
* During the fight against [[Vanstrom Klause]]
* During the fight against [[Fragment of Seren]] 
* During the fight against [[Lowerniel Drakan]]
* [[Farming Guild]] (with the exception of [[Hespori]]'s cave)
* [[Grand Exchange]]
* [[Jormungand's Prison]]
* [[Nightmare Zone]]
* [[Player-owned house]]
* [[Soul Wars]]
* [[Ungael]] crater
* [[Tombs of Amascut]] lobby
* [[Theatre of Blood]] bank area
* On a sailing boat
* [[Guardians of the Rift]]

==Types of thralls==
*[[Ghostly thrall]]s, who attack with [[Magic]]
**[[Lesser ghostly thrall]]
**[[Superior ghostly thrall]]
**[[Greater ghostly thrall]]
*[[Skeletal thrall]]s, who attack with [[Ranged]]
**[[Lesser skeletal thrall]]
**[[Superior skeletal thrall]]
**[[Greater skeletal thrall]]
*[[Zombified thrall]]s, who attack with [[Melee]]
**[[Lesser zombified thrall]]
**[[Superior zombified thrall]]
**[[Greater zombified thrall]]

== Combat Achievements==

There is a medium [[combat achievement]] (worth 2 points) called [[Sit Back and Relax]] which requires the player to deal 100 damage to creatures using undead thralls. This can be accomplished accumulatively across multiple undead thrall casts and multiple enemies.

|date = 3 November 2026
|update = Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More
|change = 
* Attenuation radius for thralls [[sound effect]]s has been reduced from 12 tiles to 1 tile.
* 1x1 NPCs [[Choose Option|minimenu]] options now always take priority over thralls.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 25 June 2025
|update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat
|change = Thralls' 100% extension is now unlocked upon reaching the Master tier of Combat Achievements, rather than Grandmaster. The 50% extension, which the tier originally held, was removed.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 June 2025
|update = Misc Galore & Yama Tweaks
|change = Thralls will no longer deal damage to [[kurask]]s and [[turoth]]s.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 5 June 2024
|update = Pride 2024
|change = A bug where ghostly thralls had their combat style set to melee has been fixed, and they should function as they did prior to the previous update.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 29 May 2024
|type = hotfix
|change = Adjusted ghostly thrall attack range due to their combat style being set to melee.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 31 January 2024
|update = Scurrius & DT2 Combat Achievements
|change = Thralls now have a better pathfinding method, allowing them to move towards a target from further away.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 9 March 2023
|update = Even More Poll 78 Changes
|change = The Thrall duration bar has been adjusted to be in line with the player’s [[Combat Achievement]] rewards.

|date = 24 August 2022
|update = Tombs of Amascut
|change = Thralls can no longer be directly interacted with.
